_comment: Items buy time, comfort or information. None of them completes a task on the player's behalf — see the Warp Stone note below for the closest call.

items.name: Rest Token
items.desc: Today counts toward your streak without a single step. Rest is training.

items.name: Hourglass
items.desc: Twelve more hours on the deadline you are currently staring at.

items.name: Tonic
items.desc: Cancels the next setback — a Snag, or Spite at their worst.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.desc: Walk straight to the door, abandoning whatever is left in the room. Needs at least one task already done — it ends a session early, it never starts one for you.

items.name: Echo Lens
items.desc: Every hidden node in this area becomes visible at once.

items.name: Scaling Chalk
items.desc: Take the easier version of the next movement and lose nothing for it.

items.name: Whistle
items.desc: The next time Spite finds you, it will be the half of them that wants you out.

items.name: Lantern
items.desc: Surfaces an Echo you have not heard yet, here and now.

items.name: Second Wind
items.desc: When the loop resets, wake where you were standing instead of in town. Once.
